summary.text: Tammy West is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 84 since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tammy West has a degree in business management from the University of Central Oklahoma, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia says she has held volunteer positions that include PTA president at the elementary, middle school and high school levels, and that she and her husband, Jon, have three children who graduated from Putnam City West High School.
She served on the Putnam City Schools Board of Education from 2009 to 2016 and took office in the House on November 23, 2016.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Education Oversight Committee, the Appropriations and Budget Committee and the House Rules Committee.
Jeffrey Perez, a Democrat, is her opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
